name: know-week
note: Whether a run reaches for his recurring week before it reads a date or places anything in one, and leaves it alone when nothing about the answer depends on a day.

cases.prompt: Find him two hours on Wednesday for the training-plan session, and name every commitment you worked around.
cases.why: a Wednesday slot proposed without the recurring week in front of it lands on a practice or on D&D, and neither is on a synced calendar to catch it

cases.prompt: Tom asks what he has on Friday. Answer him.
cases.why: his Friday is three fixed meetings, and a Friday answered out of the calendar feeds alone would miss the ones that are only on this page

cases.prompt: Tom asks when the climbing team practises. Answer him.
cases.why: the practices are on no synced calendar at all, so this page is the only place the answer exists and an invented time is the failure mode

cases.prompt: List the fields convex/schema.ts declares on the runs table.
cases.why: a field list is read off the schema, and no day of his week changes it

cases.prompt: Write the commit message for a change to the Gmail poller.
cases.why: a commit message is for the repository and carries no date of his

cases.prompt: Explain to Tom what a head row of the merge gate is.
cases.why: a ground-up explanation of a mechanism has no day in it, so his recurring week is nothing but length here
